answer_1.quote: Neural summarization systems aim to compress a document into a short paragraph or sentence ... The focus of this work is on abstractive summarization. ... We propose CTRLSUM, a framework to control summaries through a set of keywords.

answer_2.quote: We quantitatively evaluate CTRLSUM on five control aspects ... We measure ROUGE scores and the recently proposed BERTScore when ground-truth is available.

answer_4.quote: We sample 100 examples for each task, and summaries of each example from different systems are presented together in random order to the human annotator to be scored. We ask three annotators ... We ask them to provide scores over four dimensions: (1) Factual Consistency (FAC), (2) Relevance (REL), (3) Fluency (FLU), (4) Coherence (COH).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each summary on four dimensions: factual consistency, relevance, fluency, and coherence.
